description: A Perl script for extracting and displaying target, architecture, kernel, and device information from OpenWRT build system makefiles.

methods.name: parse_targetinfo
methods.description: Parses target information from makefile output, populating targets, architectures, and kernels hashes.

methods.name: parse_devices
methods.description: Parses device profiles and names from makefile output, populating devices hash.

methods.name: get_targetinfo
methods.description: Iterates over target makefiles to gather target, subtarget, and feature info.

methods.name: get_devices
methods.description: Retrieves device information for a specified target/subtarget.
